text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This report recommends that an All-Way Stop Control not be installed at the intersection of Canongate Trail and Ockwell Manor Drive (south intersection) as the existing conditions do not meet the warrant for the installation of such a traffic control device. This location currently has a stop control facing the westbound on Ockwell Manor Drive approach of this T-type intersection.

Scarborough Community Council: 1. Authorized all-way compulsory stop control at the intersection of Canongate Trail and Ockwell Manor Drive (south intersection). 2.
